craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-bhakti of salute-and-likeness — imitation as veneration; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (door-command, terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Body-as-Gods-house; bonds-poured-out. Rejected: (a) house→temple → killed: house is dwelt-in. Read aloud: I-praise, MIRR-or-ing … HERE, IN-the-BO-dy, GOD's-HOUSE.

lines: I praise, mirroring — great Lord, self, own, one-massed knowing —
bonds poured out in clusters — here, in the body, God's house.
l4.sanskrit_cite: staumi vimṛśan maheśvaram ātmānaṃ svaṃ cidekaghanam | srāvitapāśakadambakam etasmin dehadevagṛhe

reads_against.argmap: What is praised in the body-temple? → Reflecting praise of own-massed self in body-temple, bonds poured out.
c1_essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.
reads_against.c1_rasa: maṅgala-bhakti of salute; bhakti-vīra of praised alone; adbhuta of undiffering three; bhakti-adbhuta of likeness venerated; adbhuta of revealed shape; vīra of concept-free reflecting; bhakti of arranged offerings; bhakti-vīra of temple praise; vīra of conquering powers; adbhuta of corpse-seat
